nodes.summary: Let $k$ be a natural number. If a simple graph $G$ on a finite vertex set $V$ is $k$-vertex-connected, then $V$ has more than $k$ elements.
nodes.title: Vertex count of a $k$-vertex-connected graph

nodes.summary: Let $k \ge 2$ be a natural number and let $G$ be a $k$-vertex-connected simple graph on a finite vertex set $V$. Then for every vertex $v$, the subgraph of $G$ induced on $V \setminus \{v\}$ is connected.
nodes.title: Deleting one vertex from a $k$-vertex-connected graph with $k \ge 2$

nodes.summary: Let $k$ be a natural number and let $G$ be a $k$-vertex-connected simple graph on a finite vertex set $V$. Then for every set $S$ of fewer than $k$ vertices, the subgraph of $G$ induced on $V \setminus S$ is connected.
nodes.title: Deleting fewer than $k$ vertices from a $k$-vertex-connected graph

nodes.summary: Let $k \ge 1$ be a natural number. Every $k$-vertex-connected simple graph on a finite vertex set is connected.
nodes.title: A $k$-vertex-connected graph with $k \ge 1$ is connected

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a 2-vertex-connected simple graph on a finite vertex set. Then for every vertex $x$ of $G$ there is a cycle in $G$ that starts and ends at $x$.
nodes.title: Cycles through each vertex of a 2-vertex-connected graph

nodes.summary: Let $k$ be a natural number and let $G$ be a simple graph on a finite vertex set $V$. Then $G$ is $k$-vertex-connected if and only if $V$ has more than $k$ elements and, for every set $S$ of fewer than $k$ vertices, the subgraph of $G$ induced on $V \setminus S$ is connected.
nodes.title: Characterization of $k$-vertex-connectivity by vertex deletion

nodes.summary: A simple graph $G$ on a finite vertex set $V$ is 2-vertex-connected if and only if $V$ has more than two elements, $G$ is connected, and for every vertex $v$ the subgraph of $G$ induced on $V \setminus \{v\}$ is connected.
nodes.title: Characterization of 2-vertex-connected graphs

nodes.summary: Let $k$ be a natural number. A simple graph $G$ on a finite vertex set $V$ is $k$-vertex-connected if $V$ has more than $k$ elements and, for every set $S$ of fewer than $k$ vertices, the subgraph of $G$ induced on $V \setminus S$ is connected.
nodes.title: $k$-vertex-connected graph

nodes.summary: Every vertex of a 2-vertex-connected simple graph on a finite vertex set has degree at least two.
nodes.title: Degrees in a 2-vertex-connected graph are at least two

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
